sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: A regular, automatic cleanup of the workspace: remove finished work, rescue unfinished work before it is lost, and put what needs a decision in front of the owner. The owner, 2026-10-30: "It's not quite dreamtime... Although probably the same thing at a different level."

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: The first full sweep (2026-10-30) found 135 worktrees and three pieces of finished work never committed, one for two and a half months, which no other session could see (finding on stale work, this part). Dreams tidy memory; housekeeping tidies the workspace the memory is built in. Both run on a cadence, decide what they safely can, and leave the rest for a person. scripts/wt now has a read-only 'wt stale' report, the input such a cycle needs.
